facts.fact: The Lesotho Communications Authority's 2023 national household ICT access and use survey (with the Bureau of Statistics) gives internet use of 59.9% for men and 54.8% for women, a 5.1 percentage point difference (the report's text describes this as in favour of women, but its figures show the men's rate higher).
